C arc027.optional-only-when-needed OL ARC-027 MUST_NOT ;; The target structure is illustrative; create optional directories and projects only when needed. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc001.normal-projects OL ARC-001,DEP-024 DEFAULT ;; The normal Clean Architecture projects are <Name>.Domain, .Application, .Infrastructure and .Api. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep024.frontend-outside-dotnet OL DEP-024,DEP-007 DEFAULT ;; The Angular application lives outside the .NET tree in frontend/<Name>.Web/ and owns its package.json, package-lock.json, angular.json, tsconfig, src/ and public/. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep014.cli-structure OL DEP-014,DEP-003 MUST_NOT ;; Do not impose an obsolete Angular directory structure over the current CLI's; let the CLI select compatible Angular/TypeScript/RxJS versions; do not upgrade TypeScript beyond Angular's supported range. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep024.docs-when-exists OL DEP-024,ARC-027 MUST ;; Use docs/ for maintained documentation; create subdirectories (architecture/, decisions/, api/) only when such documentation exists. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep023.shared-settings OL DEP-023 DEFAULT ;; Directory.Build.props holds shared settings (TargetFramework, Nullable, ImplicitUsings, analysis/compiler settings), not project-specific ones. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep006.cpm-via-add-dependency OL DEP-006,DEP-003 MUST ;; Directory.Packages.props holds NuGet CPM with versions added through add-dependency. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.sl-global-json EX DEP-008,DEP-003 DEFAULT ;; Pin the repository to the intended .NET SDK line with global.json: select the current stable SDK for the target release (no RC/preview unless requested) and allow patch/feature-band servicing via rollForward. ;; = ;; RC/preview when explicitly requested. ;; SDK pinning via global.json is not in the oracle.
C x.sl-tooling-over-instructions EX RUN-009 PREFER ;; Keep deterministic formatting/code-style configuration in .editorconfig and prefer enforceable tooling configuration over restating mechanical formatting rules in instructions. ;; = ;; none ;; Instruction-design preference (repo/meta) not in the oracle.
C x.sl-gitignore EX SEC-001 DEFAULT ;; Ignore generated and local artifacts (bin, obj, .vs, node_modules, dist, .angular, TestResults, coverage, local secret/config overrides). ;; = ;; Where applicable. ;; Ignore-file conventions are not in the oracle (secrets aspect partially relates to SEC-001).
C dep026.dont-ignore-dev-config OL DEP-026 MUST_NOT ;; Do not ignore files intentionally part of the Development configuration contract, such as a non-secret appsettings.Development.json. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep018.optional-infra-on-requirement OL DEP-018,GOV-013,ARC-020 MUST_NOT ;; Docker files, deployment manifests, Kubernetes, cloud/messaging infrastructure and extra services are created only for a concrete requirement. ;; = ;; none ;;
